description: A Perl script designed to extract and parse target, device, architecture, kernel, and feature information from build makefiles in an OpenWRT project. It executes make commands to dump target-specific data and processes the output to compile structured information about supported targets and configurations.

methods.name: parse_targetinfo
methods.description: Parses target information from Makefile outputs, extracting target names, architectures, kernels, and features.

methods.name: parse_devices
methods.description: Parses device profiles and alternative device names from Makefile outputs, organizing device info.

methods.name: get_targetinfo
methods.description: Iterates over target Makefiles and invokes parsing functions to populate target, architecture, and kernel data.

methods.name: get_devices
methods.description: Fetches device data for a specified target/subtarget and invokes parsing.
